seed_fields.description: Train full configured populations, fit held-out thresholds and predict. Caller supplies FeatureShards stores constructed from private runtime configuration. No paths or records belong in the catalog graph. Validates disjoint groups and uses bounded frame reads; labels, sparse training CSR, fitted state and scores remain resident. Numeric callables are explicit; model construction, optimization and population policy belong to this recipe.

interfaces.name: training
interfaces.constraints: Concrete labelled FeatureShards store, nonempty finite frame vectors, nonnegative numeric sparse features and binary labels. Every label has both classes. Caller constructs stores from private local runtime configuration; no paths or records may be embedded in catalog metadata.

interfaces.name: calibration
interfaces.constraints: Concrete labelled FeatureShards store with matching feature and label widths and both classes per label. Groups are disjoint from training and query. Used only for empirical threshold fitting after all configured training epochs.

interfaces.name: query
interfaces.constraints: Concrete unlabelled FeatureShards store with matching feature width and groups disjoint from training/calibration. Unknown sparse keys are ignored under the training-only vocabulary. Every supplied query row is scored.

interfaces.name: controls
interfaces.constraints: Exact dict keys seed, hidden, epochs, batch_size, learning_rate. seed is a Python int in [0,2**32); hidden, epochs and batch_size are positive Python ints. learning_rate is a finite positive Python int or float. CPU float64 Adam/BCE neural fitting and per-label sparse L2 LBFGS with C=1, tolerance=1e-4 and max_iter=1000 are recipe policy.

interfaces.name: features
interfaces.constraints:
input features. Fit L2 binary logistic regression using LBFGS and an intercept.

Features are a nonempty canonical float64 scipy CSR matrix; aligned int64
labels (N,) contain both 0 and 1. C (inverse regularization) and tolerance
are finite positive Python numbers; maximum_iterations is a positive Python
int and seed is a Python int in [0,2**32). Controls are caller supplied.
No feature scaling, weighting, class balancing or split policy is imposed.

Returns a fitted sklearn LogisticRegression. Nonconvergence raises rather
than returning a partial fit. Native thread pools are limited to one during
fitting; caller owns aggregate concurrency. A sparse copy protects input
storage. Fitted coefficients remain dense; source features are not densified.

interfaces.name: values
interfaces.constraints:
input values. Softmax-weighted reduction of values (B,T,F) over valid positions.

Logits (B,T) share the floating dtype and device of values; mask is boolean
(B,T) on the same device. Dimensions are nonempty, every row has a valid
position, and valid values/logits must be finite. Masked entries may be
nonfinite: they are replaced before arithmetic and receive zero gradient.
Returns pooled values (B,F) and weights (B,T), preserving autograd, dtype
and device. Inputs are unchanged. No score model, position encoding,
training, padding generation or application-specific policy is included.

interfaces.name: scores
interfaces.constraints:
input scores. Maximize held-out empirical F1 independently for each score column.

Nonempty finite float64 scores (N,L) in [0,1] and aligned int64 binary
labels are required; every column must contain both classes. Predictions
use score >= threshold. Among equal computed float64 F1 values, choose
the highest observed-score threshold. Tied scores are processed together.
Returns a new float64 vector (L,); inputs are unchanged. Sorting takes
O(L*N*log(N)) time and O(N) temporary memory per column.

Caller must enforce training/calibration/query separation. This fits a
decision threshold, not calibrated probabilities or unbiased accuracy.
No expected-F1 approximation, class weighting or domain policy is used.

interfaces.name: records
interfaces.constraints:
input records. Consume numeric mappings once and return fitted vocabulary and CSR rows.

Accepts a nonempty iterable, including a one-shot generator, of mappings
from nonempty string keys to finite real values (booleans excluded). Signed
and zero values are accepted. Empty rows are allowed but the total feature
vocabulary must be nonempty. Columns use sorted feature names. Returns a
fitted sklearn DictVectorizer and float64 CSR matrix in input row order.

Source mappings are validated and copied one at a time, never materialized
as a full list. The output CSR and vocabulary remain resident. Caller owns
training/query separation and must not mutate fitted state between calls.
No categorical encoding, labels, scaling or application policy is imposed.

ignored; empty mappings yield all-zero rows. Does not refit or mutate state
or input mappings. Source mappings are consumed once; output CSR is resident.

limits: Three complete synthetic executions, including 80 epochs; no historical competition accuracy claim.
Recipe and original CDG approval remain pending. Earlier 100-test numerical evidence is source-pinned, not reported as rerun here.

policy_review.populations: Require labelled training/calibration and unlabelled query, aligned widths, disjoint groups and both classes per training/calibration label.
policy_review.optimization: Full caller-configured epochs and batches; learned attention and context gates; CPU float64 Adam with binary cross entropy.
policy_review.sparse_branch: Training-only sorted vocabulary, one L2 LBFGS classifier per label with C=1, tolerance=1e-4, max_iter=1000 and caller seed.
policy_review.combination: Equal ordered neural/sparse mean per label; empirical held-out F1 thresholds with inclusive application to every query row.
policy_review.reuse: Nine independently selectable numerical atoms; population, model, optimizer and split policies remain explicit in this recipe.

limitations: Automated Tier 3 only; no human Tier 1 or usage-qualified Tier 2 claim.
Three complete synthetic catalog-graph executions are immutable prior evidence, not rerun by this review; earlier 100-test numerical evidence is source-pinned by intake qualification.
Only the nine exact reviewed callables are qualified; arbitrary substitution is not covered.
Caller-owned FeatureShards stores are concrete runtime objects, not portable serialized inputs. Private data and paths are excluded from catalog artifacts.
Frame reads are bounded; training labels, sparse CSR, model state and output scores remain resident. No constant-total-memory guarantee.
No historical competition accuracy, rare-label improvement or generalization guarantee.
Runtime qualification covers the installed CPU environment; package file integrity does not establish publisher authentication or portability.
Original CDG scope and publication remain separate gates.
